note: Family-run RV park in the woods above Table Rock Lake on State Hwy YY outside Shell Knob, with a gas station and store at the entrance and private trails down to the Corps shoreline. Monthly stays and rig storage alongside the nightly sites. --Claude
summary: Kept: nightly $45 (lakeview 70/75 $60), full hookups 50 A, 82 sites, year-round, operator request-to-book engine; passes price, presence (own site + phone, Google 4.4/463) and the five long-stay tests (17 of 82 sites sold for a November weeknight). Operator's '43 lakeview sites' is a waterfront re-audit lead.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted nightly $45 (operator's own engine, read 2026-11-09 for 2026-11-17, 2027-05-11, 2027-07-13: most sites $45, lakeview sites 70 and 75 $60) - under $50, no gateway needed (gateways.py: Branson 31 km). Presence: working operator site tablerockarea71.com with phone 417-337-7171 and a live availability search; Google Maps 'Area71 RV Park Shell Knob' 4.4 from 463 reviews, phone +1 417-337-7171, website tablerockarea71.com. Not on RV Life; Good Sam directory row not a GS Park (stored evidence). Reviews not opened.

LONG-STAY TESTS (the park sells monthly stays with a 6-month minimum and markets a 'home base' with decks, sheds and winter storage): (1) $45 - pass; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site with a phone and an online search that sells one night (a request form, 'park staff confirm every booking'; it asks RV type/year/length and plate, no application, photos or background check) - pass; (3) no nightly minimum stated; the 6-month minimum is for monthly sites only - pass; (4) the engine offered 17 of 82 sites for one night on Tue 2026-11-17 and 14 on 2027-05-11 and 2027-07-13 (~17-21%, over 1 in 10) - pass; (5) no homes or lots sold - pass. Read as a mixed nightly/monthly park, not mostly seasonal: keep.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront): the operator claims '82 sites under the trees above Table Rock Lake, 43 of them with a view of the water' and its photo captions show views from RV sites ('A lakeview RV site in the morning, Table Rock Lake beyond the trees', 'Open site 10 on Xander's Way with a distant Table Rock Lake view', 'Site 22 with an open outlook toward Table Rock Lake'). On imagery the nearest arm of the lake is ~450-550 m east of the loops past a wooded slope, so at most a filtered/distant view - under the 2026-11-01 ruling (a filtered view in official campsite photos from a few RV sites is enough for a *view) this reads as a lakeview candidate; not changed here.
Pin 36.6072,-93.5676 sits on the front pull-in rows inside the park, ~90 m from the centre of the site area - fine. (Google's pin is the store at the entrance.)
Website and phone match the operator site and Google.
Note rewritten: hookups/monthly price moved to fields.
